source_board_geometry.batching: Concatenated primitives per native node/material; no simplification or geometry alteration.
source_board_geometry.visible_geometry: Native board outline, holes, outer tracks/pads, silkscreen and soldermask from the portable PCB after zone refill; use native viewer for filled copper layers.

public_component_geometry.body_xy_basis: Saved native Fab graphics excluding text, otherwise courtyard/body envelope. No supplier model geometry.
public_component_geometry.display_height_policy: Independent display assumptions except7.0mm published XAL7070 maximum.

coordinates.mapping: PCB X -> GLB X; PCB Y -> GLB Z; GLB Y is upward; F bodies positiveY, B bodies negativeY
coordinates.origin: Native default KiCad origin; no centering or normalization applied

credits.scope: Geometry generated from the frozen native PCB; source CAD unchanged.
238 independent nominal previews from native drawing/pad datums; no supplier body meshes used.
Published7.0mmMAX coil height only; nominal box independently authored.
Inherited carrier board outline, source footprint/route datums retained in the native PCB.

qualification: Native board geometry and nominal component body envelopes; heights are display assumptions. Not assembled-fit or hardware qualification.
manufacturer_part_number_policy: Case-insensitive alphanumeric field keys: manufacturerpn > mpn > manufacturerpartnumber > mfrpn > mfrpartnumber. Internal PARTNUMBER codes, Current_manufacturer_part_number annotations and Value are excluded.
